L0: # The Price object
L1: 
L2: Read this page in your terminal: [install the Stripe CLI](https://docs.stripe.com/cli/install) (v1.43.3+) and run `stripe docs`. [Reference](https://docs.stripe.com/cli/docs)
L3: ## Start here: Integrate with Stripe using skills and plugins
L4: 
L5: Stripe provides skills and plugins for agents to build faster and more accurately. See [Agent skills](https://docs.stripe.com/skills.md) for more information.
L6: 
L7: **Quickstart**: Install the Stripe CLI with `npm install -g @stripe/cli` and run `stripe agent setup`.
L8: > Nested parameters, fields, and event types on API reference pages are collapsed by default. Use the provided `?query=<name>` links to show the full definitions. Request the page with an empty `?query=` to expand every entry at once.
L9: ### The Price object
L10: ```json
L11: {
L12:   "id": "price_1MoBy5LkdIwHu7ixZhnattbh",
L13:   "object": "price",
L14:   "active": true,
L15:   "billing_scheme": "per_unit",
L16:   "created": 1679431181,
L17:   "currency": "usd",
L18:   "custom_unit_amount": null,
L19:   "livemode": false,
L20:   "lookup_key": null,
L21:   "metadata": {},
L22:   "nickname": null,
L23:   "product": "prod_NZKdYqrwEYx6iK",
L24:   "recurring": {
L25:     "interval": "month",
L26:     "interval_count": 1,
L27:     "trial_period_days": null,
L28:     "usage_type": "licensed"
L29:   },
L30:   "tax_behavior": "unspecified",
L31:   "tiers_mode": null,
L32:   "transform_quantity": null,
L33:   "type": "recurring",
L34:   "unit_amount": 1000,
L35:   "unit_amount_decimal": "1000"
L36: }
L37: ```
L38: ## Attributes
L39: 
L40: - `id` (string)
L41:   Unique identifier for the object.
L42: 
L43: - `object` (string, value is "price")
L44:   String representing the object’s type. Objects of the same type share the same value.
L45: 
L46: - `active` (boolean)
L47:   Whether the price can be used for new purchases.
L48: - `billing_scheme` (enum)
L49:   Describes how to compute the price per period. Either `per_unit` or `tiered`. `per_unit` indicates that the fixed amount (specified in `unit_amount` or `unit_amount_decimal`) will be charged per unit in `quantity` (for prices with `usage_type=licensed`), or per unit of total usage (for prices with `usage_type=metered`). `tiered` indicates that the unit pricing will be computed using a tiering strategy as defined using the `tiers` and `tiers_mode` attributes.
L50: Possible enum values:
L51:   - `per_unit`
L52:   - `tiered`
L53: - `created` (timestamp)
L54:   Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
L55: 
L56: - `currency` (enum)
L57:   Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://docs.stripe.com/currencies.md).
L58: - [`currency_options`](https://docs.stripe.com/api/prices/object.md?query=currency_options) (map, nullable, expandable (can be expanded into an object with the `expand` request parameter))
L59:   Prices defined in each available currency option. Each key must be a three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html) and a [supported currency](https://docs.stripe.com/currencies.md).
L60: - [`custom_unit_amount`](https://docs.stripe.com/api/prices/object.md?query=custom_unit_amount) (object, nullable)
L61:   When set, provides configuration for the amount to be adjusted by the customer during Checkout Sessions and Payment Links.
L62: 
L63: - `livemode` (boolean)
L64:   If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
L65: - `lookup_key` (string, nullable)
L66:   A lookup key used to retrieve prices dynamically from a static string. This may be up to 200 characters.
L67: 
L68: - `metadata` (map)
L69:   Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata.md) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format.
L70: 
L71: - `nickname` (string, nullable)
L72:   A brief description of the price, hidden from customers.
L73: - `product` (string, expandable (can be expanded into an object with the `expand` request parameter))
L74:   The ID of the product this price is associated with.
L75: 
L76: - [`recurring`](https://docs.stripe.com/api/prices/object.md?query=recurring) (object, nullable)
L77:   The recurring components of a price such as `interval` and `usage_type`.
L78: - `tax_behavior` (enum, nullable)
L79:   Only required if a [default tax behavior](https://docs.stripe.com/tax/products-prices-tax-categories-tax-behavior.md#setting-a-default-tax-behavior-\(recommended\)) was not provided in the Stripe Tax settings. Specifies whether the price is considered inclusive of taxes or exclusive of taxes. One of `inclusive`, `exclusive`, or `unspecified`. Once specified as either `inclusive` or `exclusive`, it cannot be changed.
L80: Possible enum values:
L81:   - `exclusive`
L82:   - `inclusive`
L83:   - `unspecified`
L84: - [`tiers`](https://docs.stripe.com/api/prices/object.md?query=tiers) (array of objects, nullable, expandable (can be expanded into an object with the `expand` request parameter))
L85:   Each element represents a pricing tier. This parameter requires `billing_scheme` to be set to `tiered`. See also the documentation for `billing_scheme`.
L86: - `tiers_mode` (enum, nullable)
L87:   Defines if the tiering price should be `graduated` or `volume` based. In `volume`-based tiering, the maximum quantity within a period determines the per unit price. In `graduated` tiering, pricing can change as the quantity grows.
L88: Possible enum values:
L89:   - `graduated`
L90:   - `volume`
L91: - [`transform_quantity`](https://docs.stripe.com/api/prices/object.md?query=transform_quantity) (object, nullable)
L92:   Apply a transformation to the reported usage or set quantity before computing the amount billed. Cannot be combined with `tiers`.
L93: 
L94: - `type` (enum)
L95:   One of `one_time` or `recurring` depending on whether the price is for a one-time purchase or a recurring (subscription) purchase.
L96: Possible enum values:
L97:   - `one_time`
L98:   - `recurring`
L99: - `unit_amount` (integer, nullable)
L100:   The unit amount in the smallest currency unit to be charged, represented as a whole integer if possible. Only set if `billing_scheme=per_unit`.
L101: 
L102: - `unit_amount_decimal` (decimal string, nullable)
L103:   The unit amount in the smallest currency unit to be charged, represented as a decimal string with at most 12 decimal places. Only set if `billing_scheme=per_unit`.
